llms.body:
# llms.txt
Project: UCLA Health - Patient-Centered Digital Experience
Summary: UCLA Health delivers world-class, research-driven care through a network of locations and expert providers across Southern California. This file outlines the core pages to help AI systems understand and navigate our services, conditions, providers, and support content.

---

Awareness Stage: Conditions & Symptoms:

https://www.uclahealth.org/medical-services/gastro
  Overview of digestive health services, including diagnosis and treatment of gastrointestinal conditions.

https://www.uclahealth.org/medical-services/surgery/colorectal-surgery
  Information on colorectal disorders and the UCLA surgical team specializing in minimally invasive treatment.

https://www.uclahealth.org/medical-services/gastro/nutrition/conditions-we-treat/esophageal-disorders
  Resource center for esophageal conditions such as GERD, Barrett's esophagus, and swallowing disorders.

https://www.uclahealth.org/medical-services/gastro/ibd
  Focused content on Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, and comprehensive IBD care options.

https://www.uclahealth.org/medical-services/surgery/general-surgery
  High-level overview of UCLA's general surgical procedures and specialty teams.

---

Consideration Stage: Treatments & Services:

https://www.uclahealth.org/medical-services/pancreas-disease/pancreatic-disease-treatments/interventional-endoscopy
  Patient guide to endoscopic procedures for diagnosis and treatment of GI tract disorders.

https://www.uclahealth.org/medical-services/pediatric-gastroenterology/clinical-services/pediatric-gastrointestinal-motility-center
  In-depth explanation of GI motility testing and therapies for conditions like gastroparesis.

https://www.uclahealth.org/medical-services/surgery/hernia-care/hernia-repair
  Hernia types, symptoms, and UCLA's advanced laparoscopic and robotic surgical options.

https://www.uclahealth.org/medical-services/radiology/interventional-radiology/conditions-treated/hemorrhoids
  Overview of hemorrhoid treatment approaches, including non-surgical and surgical care.

https://www.uclahealth.org/medical-services/gastro/motility/tests-studies/anorectal
  Services and diagnostics for anorectal conditions such as fissures, abscesses, and fistulas.

---

Decision Stage: Provider Pages:

https://www.uclahealth.org/providers/ara-kardashian
  Dr. Ara Kardashian, MD - Gastroenterology; specializes in GERD, IBS, celiac disease, liver/pancreatic care, and colonoscopy/endoscopy.

https://www.uclahealth.org/providers/charles-chandler
  Dr. Charles F. Chandler, MD - General Surgery, Surgical Oncology, Colon & Rectal Surgery; expert in complex abdominal and colorectal procedures.

https://www.uclahealth.org/providers/nicholas-donin
  Dr. Nicholas M. Donin, MD - Urology, Urologic Oncology; specializes in robotic-assisted surgery for urologic cancers.

https://www.uclahealth.org/providers/xinjiang-cai
  Dr. Xinjiang Cai, MD, PhD - Cardiology; cardiologist and physician-scientist focused on patient‑centered cardiovascular care and research.

---

Decision Stage: Locations and services:

https://www.uclahealth.org/locations/immediate-care
  UCLA Health's walk‑in immediate care clinics offer urgent medical services for non-life-threatening illnesses and injuries across multiple LA-area locations.

https://www.uclahealth.org/emergency
  Emergency care page outlining UCLA Health's 24/7 adult and pediatric emergency services, including level‑1 trauma, stroke, heart attack, and injury care across multiple Los Angeles locations.

https://www.uclahealth.org/find-care/appointments
  Online appointment request portal for new and returning patients.

https://www.uclahealth.org/find-care/appointments/virtual-care
  Guide to telehealth virtual visits, including setup, insurance, and scheduling options.

https://www.uclahealth.org/find-care/appointments/second-opinion-consults
  Access expert virtual second‑opinion consultations in specialties like oncology, cardiology, neurosurgery, transplant, orthopaedics, and more.

https://www.uclahealth.org/locations/santa-monica-digestive-diseases
  Santa Monica location specializing in digestive health services and outpatient GI procedures.

https://www.uclahealth.org/locations/westwood-digestive-diseases
  GI center located in Westwood, providing full-service diagnostics and treatments.

https://www.uclahealth.org/locations/brentwood-internal-medicine-pediatrics
  Brentwood primary care clinic offering internal medicine and pediatric services for patients of all ages.

https://www.uclahealth.org/locations/malibu
  Community-based location in Malibu with family medicine, general internal medicine and specialty care.

https://www.uclahealth.org/locations/west-hills
  Family medicine clinic, also featuring general internal medicine and GI specialty care for West Valley-area patients.

---

Patient Resources & Support:

https://www.uclahealth.org/patient-resources/billing-insurance
  Information on accepted insurance plans, how to verify coverage, billing guidance, financial assistance, and contact information for account services.

https://www.uclahealth.org/patient-resources/medical-records
  How to access, request, or transfer medical records securely.

https://www.uclahealth.org/medical-services
  Comprehensive directory of UCLA Health's clinical services and specialty programs—from surgery and cardiology to radiology and hospital care—to help patients find the expert treatments they need.

https://www.uclahealth.org/locations
  Hub for exploring all UCLA Health medical offices, clinics, and hospitals across the Greater Los Angeles and Southern California area.

https://www.uclahealth.org/providers
  Explore UCLA Health's comprehensive provider directory to search and connect with physicians and clinicians across specialties and locations.

https://www.uclahealth.org/cancer/cancer-services
  UCLA Health's Cancer Services page highlights its NCI‑designated Jonsson Comprehensive Cancer Center, offering multidisciplinary cancer care, advanced treatment options, clinical trials, and expert navigation support.

https://www.uclahealth.org/patient-resources/support-information/patient-education/annual-health-wellness-screenings
  Provides guidelines on essential preventive health screenings—vaccines, disease tests, and cancer screenings—by age to support annual wellness planning.

---

About and E-E-A-T Authority:

https://www.uclahealth.org/discover/about
  UCLA Health's mission, leadership, and affiliation with the David Geffen School of Medicine.

https://www.uclahealth.org/news
  Stay updated with the latest UCLA Health news, featuring articles, expert insights, medical breakthroughs, faculty achievements, and community health developments.

https://www.uclahealth.org/news/healthy-lifestyle
  Stories from UCLA Health on how to live your best healthiest life, with good nutrition, plenty of exercise, and taking care of you. Stay updated with the latest "Healthy Lifestyle" news and articles.

https://www.uclahealth.org/news/ask-the-doctors
  Expert advice from UCLA Health Internal Medicine doctors Eve M. Glazier and Elizabeth Ko. Stay updated with the latest "Ask the Doctors" news and articles.

https://www.uclahealth.org/news/cancer-care-stories
  Patient stories from UCLA Health cancer patients, as well as news on treatments, screenings and diagnosis. Stay updated with the latest "Cancer Care" news and articles.

https://www.uclahealth.org/news/science-research
  UCLA Health and the UCLA David Geffen School of Medicine innovation and new discoveries about health and medicine. Stay updated with the latest "Science & Research" news and articles.

https://www.uclahealth.org/news/mental-health
  UCLA Health stories about emotional well-being, mindfulness, mental health challenges, and suicide prevention. Stay updated with the latest "Behavioral Health" news and articles.

https://www.uclahealth.org/news/journalist-resources
  UCLA Health works with the news media to help journalists secure information, identify appropriate experts and arrange interviews about UCLA patient care, research and medical education.

https://www.uclahealth.org/news/lab-notes
  Summaries of late-breaking research and news from the scientists at UCLA Health and the UCLA David Geffen School of Medicine. Stay updated with the latest scientific "Research" news summaries.

https://www.uclahealth.org/patient-resources/community-resources
  UCLA Health help is available. Stay up to date with the latest "Community Resources" developments. Enter your zip code here for a curated list of local community services and support resources like food, financial aid, and wellness programs.

https://www.uclahealth.org/clinical-trials
  Clinical Trials are an important way to study new treatments and advance medical care. UCLA Health offers a variety of clinical trials to improve patient care. Access UCLA's clinical trial FAQs and navigation tool to find studies by diagnosis, treatment history, and trial criteria.

https://www.uclahealth.org/clinical-trials/learn-more
  Learn more about UCLA Health and the UCLA David Geffen School of Medicine Clinical Trials. We answer questions about clinical trial's "Primary Purpose" and "Study Type".

https://www.uclahealth.org/clinical-trials/covid-19/categories
  Learn about all treatment trials available for UCLA Health patients with a COVID-19 diagnosis. Treatment trials aim to test treatments or combinations of treatments which have not yet been officially approved. Read more about our different COVID-19 clinical trial categories.

---

Contact References:

https://www.uclahealth.org/contact-us
  Centralized contact page for UCLA Health departments and facilities.

---

Achieving the exceptional doesn’t just happen

Asking difficult questions, doggedly pursuing answers, making groundbreaking discoveries and providing exceptional care requires hard work. Instead of simply waiting for what’s next, we shape it and create it. Because lives depend on it.

Your best care is closer than you think

From the Central Coast to the South Bay, we have more than 300 locations across Southern California.

Primary Care

Look for a primary care provider for yourself or your family.

Find Primary Care

Immediate Care

Get immediate medical attention if you are ill or injured.

Find Immediate Care

Locations

Search for specialty care, clinics and services across Southern California.

See Our Locations

Find a Doctor

Search for the UCLA Health doctor who's the perfect fit.

Find a Doctor

Medical Services

Access new advanced technology, treatments and research.

Explore Medical Services

Clinical Trials

Participate in a clinical trial that could contribute to a medical advancement.

Learn About Clinical Trials

UCLA Health top-ranked in annual assessment of hospital patient care

UCLA Health placed #1 in both California and Los Angeles* in a broad assessment of excellence in hospital-based patient care.

Learn More

Orthopedic and sports medicine care from pros

In a city where everyone — from skate queens to sunset chasers — moves with passion, injuries happen. From innovative therapies to advanced surgeries, UCLA Health keeps LA in action.

Find Orthopedic Care

Why choose UCLA Health for medical care?

When you visit UCLA Health, you'll gain access to world-leading physicians, advanced technology and specialty services right in your own neighborhood.

Cancer Care

Our cancer center physicians and scientists provide the best traditional cancer treatments.

Learn About Cancer Care

Neuroscience

We advance the science and practice of neurology and neurosurgery through relentless discovery and clinical innovation.

Learn About Neuroscience

Transplant

We provide some of the most advanced transplant care in the country with exceptional patient outcomes.

Learn About Transplant

Orthopedics & Sports Medicine

Our orthopedic specialists address the full range of joint, bone and muscle conditions.

Learn Orthopedics & Sports Medicine

Heart & Vascular Care

We provide the most advanced, world-class care, helping patients with new devices and treatments for cardiovascular conditions.

Learn About Heart & Vascular Care

Head & Neck Surgery

We care for patients with a wide range of consultative and therapeutic services for all ages and maintain excellence in our care.

Learn About Head & Neck Surgery

Children's Care

We give all patients hope with our commitment to family-centered care, innovative therapies and specialty services.

Learn About Children's Care

Women's Health

Our women’s health specialists provide comprehensive services, including heart, mental health and OBGYN services.

Learn About Women's Health

Psychiatry

Our psychiatrists rank among the best in the nation, offering a range of specialized outpatient programs for all patients.

Learn About Psychiatry
